subject: English
question_text: Read the beginning of a story. Write ten new sentences
stimulus: to complete the story. 1×10=10 One day a boy was waking along a railway. At a certain place he saw a break in the line. Somebody might have removed the rail track. He thought railway driver might not be aware of the break and surely there would be an accident...............
guide_solution: Story writing  Title : Noble deed of a cow boy See Govt. Laboratory High School, Rajshahi. Sl. No. 38; Page No. 89
source: SSC English 1st Paper Test Paper 125 — Holy Cross Girls' High School, Dhaka
